core_meaning.primary_meaning: Jafar is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Small Stream, Rivulet”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Jafar corresponds to the Arabic form جعفر (Arabic جَعْفَر (Jaʿfar)). Its core sense is ja'far; a male given name. Jafar is Arabic جَعْفَر (Jaʿfar), a well-documented male given name borne by Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The source gloss 'Small Stream, Rivulet' is unsupported; the name is a proper name. Same name as jaffar, jaffer and jaafar.
